card.name: Decimal point inside clinical numbers
card.fires_on: The decimal point between digits in a reported figure, such as a percentage or measurement in adverse-reaction or trial results. It fires on the point itself, after one or two leading digits.

modes.label: Percentages
modes.description: Decimal point inside an incidence percentage for adverse events.

modes.label: Measurements and ranges
modes.description: Decimal point inside a lab value, mean change, or time range.
modes.example: in an average of 2.8 minutes (range: 1<<.>>8 to 6.7 minutes)

card.plain: It marks the decimal point in a number like 1.6% in a results table or sentence.
